name: Entropy Reversal cuts incoming disease duration by 40% natively (#1276)
contract: Spell.dbc gives Entropy Reversal 520780 a single self-targeted APPLY_AURA effect: aura 245 SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL, EffectMiscValue 3 (DISPEL_DISEASE), EffectBasePoints -41 with DieSides 1 -> -40. The tooltip reads 'Reduces the duration of disease effects by -40%'. The aura type has a real consumer: Unit::ModSpellDuration reads durationMod_always = target->GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL, spellProto->Dispel) and applies AddPct(duration, durationMod), inside the 'if (!positive)' branch, i.e. for negative auras only. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works. FIXTURE: the disease is Ghoul Rot 83985 - Dispel 3 (Disease), DurationIndex 6 = 600000 ms, Mechanic 0 and EffectMechanic 0 (so the separate SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD block above it is inert), SpellFamilyName 0 and Mechanic 0 (so no diminishing-returns group), and SPELL_ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF (0x04000000), which makes SpellInfo::_IsPositiveEffect return false so a self-cast is flagged AFLAG_NEGATIVE by AuraApplication::_InitFlags. It must be applied by a real cast: the set_aura action goes through Unit::AddAura -> Aura::TryRefreshStackOrCreate, which never calls Unit::ModSpellDuration, so a set_aura fixture would show no reduction whether or not the aura type works. Expected: 600000 ms on the control, 360000 ms on the talented Chronomancer, a ratio of 0.60.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning the passive applies its aura
The control caught the fixture disease
The talented Chronomancer caught the fixture disease
Disease duration on the untalented control (600000 ms)
The talented Chronomancer's disease lasts 40% less (360000 ms)
